create_rloo_trainer: create an RLOOTrainer instance with a model, reward functions, and training dataset for RLHF fine-tuning
train_model_rloo: train a language model using the RLOO reinforcement learning algorithm with custom reward functions
generate_completions: generate text completions from prompts using vLLM or transformers with configurable sampling parameters
calculate_rewards: compute per-token rewards from multiple reward functions including model-based and custom callable rewards
compute_loss_rloo: compute the RLOO clipped surrogate loss with advantage normalization and entropy regularization
